defective_pattern: Appending w:bidiVisual at the end of w:tblPr after w:tblW and w:tblLook, violating ECMA-376 sequence order.
why_defective: Violating ECMA-376 sequence order causes strict parsers like ONLYOFFICE to drop RTL table direction and render handle [+] on left and columns LTR.
observed_symptoms: Table handle [+] appears on left instead of right in ONLYOFFICE.
Table columns render Left-to-Right in ONLYOFFICE despite having w:bidiVisual.
corrective_remedy: Insert bidiVisual w:val="1" strictly before tblW in the CT_TblPr schema ordering.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex detecting w:tblW or w:tblLook followed by w:bidiVisual
